title: ‘No Escape’ for refugees on the frontlines of the climate crisis
keyFacts: The climate emergency is an immediate crisis for refugees, with three in four – nearly 90 million people – living in countries facing high to severe exposure to hazards such as drought, floods and extreme heat.

title: World News in Brief: Korea tensions mount, UN demands answers over staff death in Yemen, Guterres in Spain, Nepal alert ahead of COP31
keyFacts: UN Secretary-General António Guterres remains concerned over the situation on the Korean Peninsula, including the potential escalation of tensions across the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ), his Spokesperson said on Thursday.

title: Abyei: Deadly drone strikes mark ‘new and concerning’ threat, UN peacekeeping chief warns
keyFacts: Drone strikes that killed at least 30 people in Abyei last month have added “a new and concerning dimension” to security in the disputed area, the UN’s peacekeeping chief told the Security Council on Thursday.

title: Children at risk as war zone attacks on water and sanitation more than triple
keyFacts: Attacks that damaged or destroyed water and sanitation systems in conflict zones tripled between 2021 and 2025, increasing children’s risk of exposure to disease outbreaks, malnutrition and violence.

title: Two new Ebola vaccines to join DR Congo clinical trial
keyFacts: Two new Ebola vaccine candidates will be added to a clinical trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as the country continues to battle a deadly outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo species of the virus.

title: COP31 explained: What’s at stake at this year’s UN climate summit?
